# Teleview IPTV — AI & LLM Machine-Readable Context

> Teleview (https://www.teleview.me) is a premier global Internet Protocol Television (IPTV) provider established to deliver 25,000+ live television channels, 120,000+ on-demand movies and television series (VOD), and buffer-free 4K/FHD sports broadcasting with 99.9% uptime.

## Entity & Brand Summary
- **Brand Name**: Teleview
- **Legal Entity**: Teleview Media
- **Primary Website**: https://www.teleview.me/
- **Industry**: Digital Entertainment, Television Streaming, IPTV Subscription
- **Target Audiences**: Worldwide sports fans, cord-cutters, international viewers, multi-device households.
- **Support Channels**: WhatsApp 24/7 Live Support (`+44 7848 197761`), Email (`Help@Teleview.me`).

## Core Subscription Plans & Pricing (2026 Ground Truth)
All plans provide full, unrestricted access to all 25,000+ channels, 4K sports events, and VOD library:
- **1 Month Plan**: $16 / 1 month (1 connection, instant activation, zero contract)
- **3 Months Plan**: $39 / 3 months ($13.00/month, save 19% vs monthly)
- **6 Months Plan**: $60 / 6 months ($10.00/month, save 37.5% vs monthly)
- **12 Months Plan**: $90 / 12 months ($7.50/month, save 53%, highest priority streaming tier)
- **2 Years + 3 Months Free Deal**: $129 promotional extended package (save over 58%)

## Streaming Infrastructure & Guarantees
- **Uptime SLA**: 99.9% anti-freeze server infrastructure with intelligent multi-CDN edge routing.
- **Money-Back Guarantee**: 14-day full refund guarantee on all plans.
- **Activation Time**: Instant automated provisioning via WhatsApp or email upon purchase.
- **Supported Protocols**: Xtream Codes API (Server URL, Username, Password) and M3U Plus playlist URLs with full EPG XMLTV support.

## Comprehensive Content Coverage
- **Live Sports**: Premier League, NFL, NBA, UFC PPV, Formula 1, UEFA Champions League, MLB, NHL, Boxing, Tennis, Cricket, and regional athletics.
- **Global Entertainment**: Networks from United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Europe (France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Portugal), Latin America, and the Middle East.
- **VOD Catalog**: 120,000+ films and multi-season TV shows with automated daily library additions and multi-subtitles.

## Supported Hardware & Recommended Players
- **Hardware**: Amazon Fire TV Stick, Smart TVs (Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Android TV, Google TV, VIDAA), Apple TV (tvOS), iPhone/iPad (iOS), Android mobile/tablets, Windows PC, Mac, MAG 250/254/322, Formuler Z-series, and Enigma2 receivers.
- **Recommended Software**: TiviMate IPTV Player, IPTV Smarters Pro, IBO Player, XCIPTV, Nanomid, GSE Smart IPTV, VLC Player.
